name: Rai, Archmage: Inherited Effect -- first Mage action card each turn, put an enlighten counter on champion
notes: Rai, Archmage's Inherited Effect (GameLogic.php ~5670-5680) checks ChampionHasInLineage, which reads the champion object's own CardID plus Subcards -- a direct CardID patch is sufficient (no natural level-up needed). Idle Thoughts (rWhFC8XBaH, NORM, MAGE, reserve 1, already used in idle-thoughts-glimpse-4 with this exact generic deck/seed, so the same Glimpse response is reused) is the first MAGE ACTION card activated this turn, putting an enlighten counter on the champion and setting the RAI_ARCHMAGE_TRIGGERED once-per-turn flag.

rulesClauses: Inherited Effect: Whenever you activate your first Mage action card each turn, put an enlighten counter on your champion.
